manifest.description: CallSieve public benchmark - natural-language retrieval slice. Thirty issues are derived from the public SWE-bench Lite subset with prompts rewritten to avoid direct file paths, symbol names, and code snippets; ground_truth_files remain the original gold patch files.

issues.task: fix incorrect independence reporting for nested combined models
support table output that includes header rows in restructured text
accept lower case commands when reading plotting data tables
keep mask handling correct when arithmetic uses an operand without a mask
read floating point table values that use nonstandard exponent letters
return empty coordinate results instead of failing on empty coordinate inputs
set safer default permissions for uploaded files
allow a file path setting on a model field to be provided lazily
preserve multiline raw ordering clauses when compiling database queries
avoid unnecessary media ordering warnings when several form assets are combined
avoid wrapping migration output in a transaction when the database cannot use one
show the correct accepted format when duration input is invalid
reject usernames that sneak in a trailing newline
allow binary memory views to be written into responses
clear the primary key after deleting an object with no related dependencies
make the proxy permission migration tolerate models that were recreated
track changes to the main management script during automatic reloads
include the configured script prefix when building static and media urls
avoid intermittent reload crashes caused by invalid null bytes
show a technical debug response when a route converter raises a missing page error
report duplicate database table names only when they come from conflicting models
check that stored text can fit the longest configured choice
keep grouping rules correct when filtering against the result of another query
serialize enumeration defaults by their member names instead of stored values
interpret two digit years in parsed internet dates using the right century
reject truthiness filters that use values other than true or false
keep renamed primary key targets correct when detecting migration changes
return choice field values with the same type after loading a saved object
let applications customize the display text for fields with configured choices
make repeated test database setup work when the temporary sqlite database is kept
